title: 0xos spec YAML frontmatter
description: Every spec MUST trace the spine. plan_ref and constitution_ref are required and non-empty — this is what makes the traceability matrix renderable and is enforced by principles-check.sh. status flips at merge via the post-merge git hook, never by hand.

subsystem.description: e.g. crates/wallet or a service name

constitution_ref.description: REQUIRED non-empty — invariant ids and/or DR ids, e.g. [I-1, DR-0007]
